description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called PreferencesScreen, which presents a user interface for managing cookie preferences. It includes an AppBar with a reset button and a scrollable list of preference options, each represented by a PreferencesListTile widget.

classes.name: PreferencesScreen
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays cookie preference options within a Scaffold, including an AppBar and a scrollable list of preference tiles.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for PreferencesScreen, including Scaffold, AppBar, and list of preference tiles.
